items.difficulty_reason: The author uses type-indexed injectivity of dependent-type erasure and partial equivalence relations to recover proper DHOL terms from PHOL proofs. The current polymorphic extension supplies the applied-type cases and full index procedure, then uses statement normalization to turn spurious intermediate derivations into admissible macro-steps before lifting validity. All current construction and detailed beta/normalization cases are retained with the original unchanged-monorphic prior proof reference. This non-routine logical translation/reflection argument supports H2 as one main result.
